OUTLAY.gloss: the act of spending or disbursing money
OUTLAY.definition: The act of spending or disbursing money.

LAYOUT.gloss: a plan or design of something that is laid out
LAYOUT.definition: A plan or design of something that is laid out.

AUTO.gloss: a motor vehicle with four wheels
AUTO.definition: A motor vehicle with four wheels; usually propelled by an internal combustion engine.
AUTO.example: He needs a car to get to work.

ALTO.gloss: a singer whose voice lies in the alto clef
ALTO.definition: A singer whose voice lies in the alto clef.

OUT.gloss: not allowed to continue to bat or run
OUT.definition: Not allowed to continue to bat or run.
OUT.example: He was tagged out at second on a close play.

LOT.gloss: a large number or amount or extent
LOT.definition: (often followed by `of') a large number or amount or extent.

LAY.gloss: put into a certain place or abstract location
LAY.definition: Put into a certain place or abstract location.

TOY.gloss: an artifact designed to be played with
TOY.definition: An artifact designed to be played with.
